name: Johnny McGorey's
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: liherald.com, instagram.com, irloc.com, johnnymcgoreys.com.
reviewNotes:
Ira's List's calendar lists West Coast Swing nights here with a full band. Research the dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Open and on Long Island (Lynbrook, Nassau County). No working website: johnnymcgoreys.com is now a parked domain. Instagram and TikTok are the profiles listed on the pub's Google business listing; the Facebook page 'Johnny McGorey's Lynbrook' was matched by name, town and posts (Irish Sundays, Friday live music) but is not linked from a website. IMPORTANT: this venue's upcoming event from Ira's List is very likely 'WCS' = Worst Case Scenario, a Long Island rock cover band (@wcs_rocks, wcsrocks.com), not West Coast Swing - and IRLOC places that show (Fri Nov 6, 6 PM, full band) at the OTHER Johnny McGorey's Pub, 131 Front St, Massapequa Park 11762, (516) 797-8584. Please check the event's venue and dance style (the Ira's List adapter reads 'WCS' as West Coast Swing). Dance floor: found no mention of a dance floor at the Lynbrook pub. No logo or photos: there is no website, Facebook/Instagram images need a login (Facebook's picture endpoint is blocked by robots.txt), and the TikTok profile picture is a group photo of people, not a logo. Hours from Google (Apple Maps shows the same); an older FANZO listing shows shorter hours.
description: An Irish pub and sports bar on Atlantic Avenue in Lynbrook, with pub food and games on TV. It has live bands on Friday evenings and has also hosted Irish music on Sunday afternoons. It is the second Johnny McGorey's; the first is in Massapequa Park.

evidence.note: Google Maps listing: Johnny McGorey's, 46 Atlantic Ave, Lynbrook NY 11563, (516) 239-2458, open every day 12 PM-4 AM, tagged 'Live music'. Profiles: Instagram @mcgoreys_lynbrook, TikTok @mcgoreys; no website.
LI Herald (Aug 2025): Johnny McGorey's at 46 Atlantic Ave in Lynbrook is the owners' second pub; their first opened in Massapequa Park about 26 years earlier.
The pub's Instagram post (seen in search results): live music every Friday from 6 to 9 PM at Johnny McGorey's Lynbrook.
The pub's Instagram/Facebook post: 'Irish Sundays' with live Irish music every Sunday 4-7 PM, starting February 15 (2026).
IRLOC: 'WCS' on Fri Nov 6, 6 PM is a full-band rock show by Worst Case Scenario at Johnny McGorey's Pub, 131 Front St, Massapequa Park - the other location, and a band, not West Coast Swing.
The old brand domain now shows a parked page (ParkLogic), so the pub has no working website.
